Promoters **R Sarabeswar** and **S Sivaramakrishnan** filed nil encumbrance declarations under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2025-26 on April 1, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹126.34 Cr (+91.3% YoY), net loss ₹12.7 Cr (against a loss of ₹0.43 Cr a year earlier).
